title: The best plan so far, from every solution the solver reports
heading: A Solve Callback Runs at Events the Solver Supports
cases: two improving solutions of a maximization are recorded as their two values, and the callback asks nothing of the solver
on a SCIP solve the history is not empty and reaches the optimum
a solution worse than the best so far records the best again
for a minimization the best so far is the lowest value seen
